div.div:
مُخْتَلِعَةٌ (tropical:) A woman divorced from her husband for a gift, or a compensation, from him, (S, K,) or from another: (K:) [see 8:] and [the pl.] مُخْتَلِعَاتٌ [is explained as signifying] (tropical:) women who incite, urge, or induce, their husbands to divorce them for a gift, or a compensation, without any injurious conduct from the latter. (TA.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) A woman affected with lust. (Sgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
